newsitem.title: INDIA: Jardine reaffirms sell on India's Larsen.
newsitem.headline: Jardine reaffirms sell on India's Larsen.

text.p: Jardine Fleming India Broking on Friday said it reiterated its earlier "sell" recommendation on shares of Indian engineering firm Larsen & Toubro (L&T).
Jardine said the recent price rise has given investors an excellent opportunity to exit from the stock.

It said the company's order book growth rate fell sharply, and the situation was not expected to improve until the first half of 1997/98 (April-March). "This is bound to impact its engineering sales in FY98," it said in a research paper.
It said the cement division's performance began deteriorating in September 1996 and the situation had worsened since then.
"To add to the above negatives, L&T's stock still has the overhang of the mega steel project, forays into property development and oil exploration," it said.
